_comment: Optional per-repo polish. A mod with no entry here still appears, using its GitHub description. Add an entry only when the card deserves better words than a one-line description.

mobile-pc.name: Mobile PC
mobile-pc.blurb: The storage PC, from anywhere. Adds PC at the very top of the START menu so you can move Pokémon without walking back to a Centre. No configuration — enable it and the entry is there.

one-exp-line.name: One EXP Line
one-exp-line.blurb: One EXP box for the whole party instead of one per Pokémon. With EXP Share on, a single battle used to cost six message boxes. Now it costs one.

1tb-agenda.name: 1TB Agenda
1tb-agenda.blurb: A phone book that never fills. Gold caps the PokéGear at ten contacts, so every new number pushes out a trainer you wanted to rematch. This lifts the cap to every contact the game can hold.

Gen2-3D-Sprites.name: Gen2 3D Sprites Plus
Gen2-3D-Sprites.blurb: A 3D voxel overworld with Stadium 2 models, and the bugs fixed — the PC box picker, the POKéGEAR map, dead encounters after the START menu, plus model size and walk-motion controls.

kurt-bulk-apricorns.name: Kurt Bulk Apricorns
kurt-bulk-apricorns.blurb: Hand Kurt every apricorn you are carrying and collect every ball at once. Pick a colour and he takes all of that colour, then asks whether he should take the rest of your bag too — and says what he took and what he made, which the cart never does. NO WAITING skips the day, touching Kurt’s flag and no other daily event.
